behavior.monotonic_lifetime: The RAII attempt is created at the checkpoint await boundary only after original current-fence/cut capture/live checks. Error, mismatch, timeout or cancellation after that point drops the attempt and stores fenced=true before the caller-owned SQLite transaction drops/releases its writer lock. Exact ACK plus the original final live check acknowledges the attempt without clearing any prior fence. No public reset exists.
behavior.admission_scope: Ordinary pool initialization remains permitted before any uncertainty. No default-closed pool is reported as successful ordinary startup. No public sender, authority or ticket APIs are replaced.
behavior.readback_and_duplicate: recovery_anchor keeps its original BEGIN IMMEDIATE and exact capture but rolls back the read-only transaction. Internal AppendOutcome::Existing is returned only by the original exact retained event-kind/bytes match, and that transaction rolls back before the original independent ACK. Inserted performs the original real COMMIT. No error check is reordered and AlreadyRetained still precedes commit.
behavior.from_read_only_pool: The existing physically read-only observer constructor stays physically read-only and owns no exclusive guard. Its new inert struct field is not an installed writer hook, protected coordinator, or Current authorization.

final_controls.name: production_writer::objective_sender::commit_interlock_tests::cancelled_checkpoint_vetoes_a_preexisting_read_transaction
final_controls.proof: A real BEGIN plus SELECT holds an existing read transaction; original checkpoint enters Hold and is cancelled. A separate no-write BEGIN IMMEDIATE/ROLLBACK proves the queued owner rollback completed before the old read transaction upgrades and receives actual COMMIT 531.

final_controls.name: production_writer::objective_sender::commit_interlock_tests::cancelled_checkpoint_vetoes_a_preexisting_connection_waiting_for_sqlite
final_controls.proof: A preexisting physical connection really polls BEGIN IMMEDIATE behind the original checkpoint writer lock. After cancellation the same handle begins, DDL succeeds within its transaction, COMMIT is 531, schema/cut unchanged; a writer capability cannot commit a new admission.

final_controls.name: production_writer::objective_sender::commit_interlock_tests::refused_checkpoint_vetoes_growth_replacement_and_writes_after_read_ack
final_controls.proof: Actual refusal precedes five simultaneously borrowed physical handles. Every implicit DDL is 531, each old handle is closed, a cloned store's replacement is 531, a true later independent read ACK succeeds, then writing still returns 531 with unchanged cut.
